inputs.text: The organizers say 8 million people attended more than 3,300 “No Kings” events across all 50 states, and claim turnout was about one million higher than in October. But there is no official count, and a movement’s own figures are not proof that the country agrees with it. These rallies are political pressure campaigns, not a substitute for lawful authority or the consent of the nation. A country governed by law and tradition cannot be run by whichever faction can stage the loudest protest.
